name: Armchair
dimensions: Measured on by object by LW
summary: This chair was made in the 18th century during the Qing dynasty, but it is in the style of the Ming (1368-1644). The wood is a timber known as 'hongmu' (red wood). Simple chairs such as this would exist side by side with more elaborate lacquered and carved furniture in an 18th-century Chinese home.
